Title: 1. Jaws
description: When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

Title: 2. The Rocky Horror Picture Show
description: A rain-soaked couple take refuge in the castle of a transvestite mad scientist from outer space who is about to unveil his greatest creation.

Title: 3. One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
description: A rebellious convict is sent to a psychiatric hospital for evaluation in 1963 Oregon, and encourages his docile companions to take more control of their lives and defy the tyrannical head nurse.

Title: 4. Dog Day Afternoon
description: Three amateur robbers plan to hold up a Brooklyn bank. A nice, simple robbery: Walk in, take the money, and run. Unfortunately, the supposedly uncomplicated heist suddenly becomes a bizarre nightmare as everything that could go wrong does.

Title: 5. Shampoo
description: On Election Day, 1968, irresponsible hairdresser and ladies' man George Roundy is too busy cutting hair and dealing with his girlfriends and mistress Felicia Karpf, whose husband Lester is having an affair with his ex-girlfriend Jackie.

Title: 6. The Return of the Pink Panther
description: Inspector Clouseau is on the case when the Pink Panther diamond is stolen from a highly secured museum, with the Phantom's trademark glove as the only clue. Clouseau is convinced the Phantom did it, but things are not what they seem to be.

Title: 7. Funny Lady
description: Story of singer Fanny Brice's stormy relationship with showman Billy Rose.

Title: 8. The Apple Dumpling Gang
description: Three orphan children strike gold in 1878 California.

Title: 9. Tommy
description: A psychosomatically blind, deaf, and mute boy becomes a master pinball player and, subsequently, the figurehead of a cult.

Title: 10. Three Days of the Condor
description: A bookish CIA researcher in Manhattan finds all his co-workers dead, and must outwit those responsible until he figures out who he can really trust.

Title: 11. Lucky Lady
description: A trio of rum-runners during prohibition in the 1930s engage in a menage-a-trois after business hours.

Title: 12. The Great Waldo Pepper
description: After WW1, an ex-pilot takes up barn-storming and chance-meets a former German ace fighter pilot with whom he co-stars in Hollywood war movies depicting aerial dog-fights.

Title: 13. Love and Death
description: In czarist Russia, a neurotic soldier and his distant cousin formulate a plot to assassinate Napoleon.

Title: 14. Escape to Witch Mountain
description: Two mysterious orphan children have extraordinary powers and are chased by a scheming millionaire. But where do these kids really call home?

Title: 15. Once Is Not Enough
description: A young woman goes home to New York after a long stay in Europe. Her former schoolmate introduces her to the decadence of New York and she ultimately falls in love with an older man who's a stand-in for her father, before tragedy strikes.

Title: 16. The Eiger Sanction
description: Classical art professor and collector Dr. Jonathan Hemlock, who doubles as a professional assassin, is coerced out of retirement to avenge the murder of an old friend.

Title: 17. French Connection II
description: "Popeye" Doyle travels to Marseille to find Alain Charnier, the drug smuggler who eluded him in New York.

Title: 18. The Smurfs and the Magic Flute
description: A villain named McCreep steals the Smurfs' magic flute, an instrument that makes people dance wildly, and uses it to rob them. The Smurf King sends out Peewit to track down the thief and retrieve the flute.

Title: 19. Give 'em Hell, Harry!
description: One-man show about the presidency of Harry S. Truman.

Title: 20. Nashville
description: Over the course of a few hectic days, numerous interrelated people prepare for a political convention.

Title: 21. Bug
description: The inhabitants of a small town find themselves under siege from mutant cockroaches that have the ability to start fires.

Title: 22. Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table embark on a surreal, low-budget search for the Holy Grail, encountering many, very silly obstacles.

Title: 23. Framed
description: A gambler kills a sheriff in self defense. But as everyone in conspiring against him, he is condemned to a long sentence in prison.

Title: 24. At Long Last Love
description: Four socialite old friends unexpectedly clash, and switch partners during a party and attempt to make each other jealous.

Title: 25. The Passenger
description: Unable to find the war he has been asked to cover, a frustrated war correspondent takes the risky path of co-opting the identity of a dead arms-deal acquaintance.

Title: 26. The Giant Spider Invasion
description: Giant spiders from another dimension invade Wisconsin.

Title: 27. Picnic at Hanging Rock
description: During a rural summer picnic, a few students and a teacher from an Australian girls' school vanish without a trace. Their absence frustrates and haunts the people left behind.

Title: 28. Switchblade Sisters
description: The leader of an inner city girl gang is challenged when a new girl moves into the neighborhood.

Title: 29. Grey Gardens
description: Meet a mother and daughter, high-society dropouts, reclusive cousins of Jackie O., managing to thrive together amid the decay and disorder of their East Hampton, NY, mansion, making for an eerily ramshackle echo of the American Camelot.

Title: 30. The Mirror
description: A dying man in his forties remembers his past. His childhood, his mother, the war, personal moments and things that tell of the recent history of all the Russian nation.

Title: 31. That Most Important Thing: Love
description: A young photojournalist meets a struggling actress on a film set, forced to make ends meet by appearing in pornographic films. Intrigued, he goes to her home to take a series of photographs.

Title: 32. Seven Beauties
description: The defense of honor, a strong value in Neapolitan society, and its effects on the life of everyman Pasquale Frafuso.

Title: 33. Fox and His Friends
description: A suggestible working-class innocent wins the lottery but lets himself be taken advantage of by his bourgeois new boyfriend and his circle of materialistic friends.

Title: 34. Mother Kusters Goes to Heaven
description: Frau Kusters is preparing dinner late one seemingly-ordinary afternoon in her seemingly-ordinary kitchen in Frankfurt, Germany. She wants to add canned sausages to the stew; her annoying daughter-in-law thinks otherwise. But the point is moot: Mr. Kusters has murdered the personnel director at the soap factory where he works--and followed that by committing suicide.

Title: 35. The Story of Adele H
description: The story of Adèle Hugo's unrequited love for a lieutenant.

Title: 36. Barry Lyndon
description: An Irish rogue wins the heart of a rich widow and assumes her dead husband's aristocratic position in 18th-century England.

Title: 37. Salò, or the 120 Days of Sodom
description: In World War II Italy, four fascist libertines round up nine adolescent boys and girls and subject them to 120 days of torture.

Title: 38. Night Moves
description: Los Angeles private investigator Harry Moseby is hired by a client to find her runaway teenage daughter. Moseby tracks the daughter down, only to stumble upon something much more intriguing and sinister.

Title: 39. Deep Red
description: Obsessed by a fleeting visual memory, English jazz pianist Marcus Daly hunts a savage, black-gloved killer through a labyrinth of nightmarish architectural spaces, promising a hyper-stylized descent into pure auditory and visual terror.

Title: 40. Jeanne Dielman, 23, quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
description: A lonely widowed housewife does her daily chores, takes care of her apartment where she lives with her teenage son, and turns the occasional trick to make ends meet, but something happens that changes her safe routine.

Title: 41. The Stepford Wives
description: Joanna Eberhart has come to the quaint little town of Stepford, Connecticut with her family, but soon discovers there lies a sinister truth in the all too perfect behavior of the female residents.

Title: 42. The Man Who Would Be King
description: In 1880s India, two former British soldiers decide to set themselves up as Kings in Kafiristan, a land where no white man has set foot since Alexander the Great.

Title: 43. Rollerball
description: A corporate dictator tries to oust the star player of a brutal 21st-century spectator sport.

Title: 44. Death Race 2000
description: In a dystopian future, a cross country automobile race requires contestants to run down innocent pedestrians to gain points that are tallied based on each kill's brutality.

Title: 45. The Chaos Class Failed the Class
description: A group of students have failed their exams and must return for another year. Distracting them all is a new young female teacher, who they try out their usual tricks on.

Title: 46. Hard Times
description: The saga of a drifter who turns to illicit bare-knuckle boxing in Depression-era New Orleans.

Title: 47. All Creatures Great and Small
description: The story of a young veterinarian's apprenticeship to a somewhat eccentric older vet in the English countryside, and the young man's hesitating courtship of the daughter of a local farmer.

Title: 48. Shivers
description: The residents of a suburban high-rise apartment building are infected by parasites that turn them into mindless nymphomaniac fiends.

Title: 49. Dersu Uzala
description: An explorer is sent on an expedition to the snowy Siberian wilderness and makes friends with a seasoned local hunter.

Title: 50. The Story of O
description: A photographer is introduced to the world of dominance and submission.

Title: 51. Doc Savage: The Man of Bronze
description: Doc and the Amazing Five battle Captain Seas and "the green death" for control of a fabulous resource.

Title: 52. Farewell, My Lovely
description: Los Angeles private detective Philip Marlowe is hired by paroled convict Moose Malloy to find his missing girlfriend Velma, a former dancer in a seedy nightclub. As the search progresses, Marlowe gets knocked out and framed for murder.

Title: 53. Ilsa: She Wolf of the SS
description: A sadistic, psychosexual Nazi camp commandant brutalizes her prisoners until an unusually resilient inmate exploits her obsessions and sparks a violent revolt amid the collapsing Reich.

Title: 54. The Day of the Locust
description: An art director in the 1930s falls in love and attempts to make a young woman an actress despite Hollywood who wants nothing to do with her because of her problems with an estranged man and her alcoholic father.

Title: 55. The Wind and the Lion
description: A Berber chieftain triggers an international incident, drawing the involvement of Theodore Roosevelt, when he kidnaps an American widow and her children in 1900s Morocco.

Title: 56. The Devil's Rain
description: A satanist cult leader is burnt alive by the local church. He vows to come back to hunt down and enslave every descendant of his congregation, by the power of the book of blood contracts, in which they sold their souls to the devil.

Title: 57. The Old Gun
description: During World War II, a peaceful French surgeon decides to ruthlessly exterminate an SS squad because of the atrocities they'd just committed in his countryside home and childhood village.

Title: 58. Bite the Bullet
description: A pair of ex-Rough Riders, a former prostitute, a gunfighter, an aging cowboy and an English gentleman enter a 700-mile horse race through the Southwest desert in 1908.

Title: 59. Supervixens
description: A hapless gas station attendant is forced to go on the run after his unfaithful wife is murdered by a psychopathic cop, and encounters a bevy of busty babes until he meets his ideal woman.

Title: 60. Emmanuelle II
description: Emmanuelle travels to Hong Kong in search of her estranged husband Jean. Her quest takes an unexpected turn when she meets Christopher, a pilot and Laura, Jean's mistress, igniting a whirlwind of extramarital affairs with Jean's knowledge.

Title: 61. Strip Nude for Your Killer
description: After a model dies during an abortion, a figure wearing a motorcycle helmet murders her doctor, then targets models and photographers from the agency she belonged to.

Title: 62. Manila in the Claws of Light
description: Júlio Madiaga, a 'provinciano', arrives in Manila to search for his beloved, Ligaya.

Title: 63. Autopsy
description: A young pathology doctor interning in a morgue tries to cope with a wave of suicides. A woman she just met kills herself, but she suspects someone close to her might have killed her.

Title: 64. Race with the Devil
description: Two couples vacationing together in an R.V. from Texas to Colorado are terrorized after they witness a murder during a Satanic ritual.

Title: 65. The Drowning Pool
description: Harper's a big-city PI, who travels to Louisiana to help an old girlfriend who's worried her husband will find out she's been cheating on him.

Title: 66. A Boy and His Dog
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a boy who can communicate with his dog telepathically is targeted by a mysterious committee.

Title: 67. The Prisoner of Second Avenue
description: A suddenly-unemployed company executive suffers a nervous breakdown, and his supporting wife tries everything to console him and pick up the slack.

Title: 68. The Adventure of Sherlock Holmes' Smarter Brother
description: The younger brother of the consulting detective tries to steal Sherlock's glory by solving an important case assisted by an eccentric Scotland Yard detective and a lovely but suspicious actress.

Title: 69. Brannigan
description: Chicago Police Lieutenant Jim Brannigan is sent to the U.K. to escort organized crime boss Ben Larkin back to the U.S., but Larkin's hitmen prepare an ambush for Brannigan.

Title: 70. The Hindenburg
description: A chronicle of the Hindenburg disaster in which a zeppelin burst into flames.

Title: 71. Mandingo
description: An 1840s slaveowner trains one of his slaves to be a bare-knuckle fighter.

Title: 72. The Reincarnation of Peter Proud
description: When college professor, Peter Proud begins experiencing flashbacks of an earlier life, he's mysteriously drawn to a place he's never been to, but which seems familiar and where he soon finds his previous incarnation's wife.

Title: 73. Night of the Seagulls
description: In this final installment of the Blind Dead series, a doctor and his wife move to a small inhospitable coastal village where he plans to start a practice only to discover that undead demon-worshiping Templar Knights haunt the place.

Title: 74. Operation Daybreak
description: In 1942, Britain sends a group of British-trained Czech commandos to Prague to assassinate SS-General Reinhard Heydrich, head of the Nazi security services.

Title: 75. The Family Vice
description: Fresh out of prison, Giacomo takes a job with the mysterious Magda, who wants a count's inheritance. As hidden motives and rival schemers emerge, Giacomo's true intentions slowly come to light.

Title: 76. Rooster Cogburn
description: Marshal Rooster Cogburn unwillingly teams up with Eula Goodnight to track down her father's murderers.

Title: 77. Paper Tiger
description: A somewhat prim and proper Englishman is hired as the tutor to the son of the Japanese ambassador. His life changes when he and the boy are kidnapped by terrorists for political purposes.

Title: 78. Cooley High
description: In 1964 on Chicago's Near-North Side, the lives of four carefree high school seniors and best friends, including an aspiring playwright and an all-city basketball champion, take a tragic turn.

Title: 79. The Flying Guillotine
description: An assassin, trained in the use of a throwing weapon that can behead its victims from a distance, questions the morality of his missions and becomes a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

Title: 80. Black Moon
description: To escape a gender war, a girl flees to a remote farmhouse and becomes part of an extensive family's unusual, perhaps even supernatural, lifestyle.

Title: 81. Wrong Move
description: A writer goes on a road trip across West Germany with a group of eclectic people he meets along the way.

Title: 82. The Promised Land
description: Three friends hope to build a factory but their plans are quickly jeopardized by local politics and one of the partner's dangerous love affair.

Title: 83. The Adventures of the Wilderness Family
description: The Robinson family decide to leave city life behind for one of clean living in the wilderness for the sake of their daughter's health. There they learn the value of family as they become closer to nature.

Title: 84. Breakout
description: A bush pilot is hired for fifty thousand dollars to go to Mexico to free an innocent prisoner.

Title: 85. Terror of Mechagodzilla
description: An Interpol investigation uncovers a shunned biologist and his daughter, who are involved in an alien plot to use Mechagodzilla and Titanosaurus to defeat Godzilla and wipe out humanity.

Title: 86. The Amusement Park
description: An elderly gentleman goes for what he assumes will be an ordinary day at the amusement park, only to find himself in the middle of a hellish nightmare.

Title: 87. Satanic Pandemonium
description: A devout nun, known for her piety, encounters a mysterious shepherd whose presence awakens forbidden desires within her, challenging her faith and self-control.

Title: 88. The Night Caller
description: Commissaire Letellier and Inspector Moissac are tracking Minos, a serial killer whose victims are women.

Title: 89. Friday Foster
description: While investigating a plot to assassinate politicians, magazine photographer Friday Foster becomes a target herself.

Title: 90. A Woman for All Men
description: A wealthy, hot-tempered man weds a beautiful but deceitful woman. His son falls for her while his daughter and housekeeper grow suspicious, leading to lies, affairs, and deadly consequences.

Title: 91. Footprints on the Moon
description: After being tormented by dreams about astronauts on the moon, a translator visits a deserted seaside town whose inhabitants know her, although she does not know them.

Title: 92. Report to the Commissioner
description: Politics skew the probe of a rookie detective's accidental shooting of an undercover policewoman.

Title: 93. Libera, My Love
description: Director Mauro Bolognini inserts this story in Fascist Italy, with careful attention to details. The couple formed by Matteo Zannoni (Bruno Cirino) and Libera Valente (Cardinale) can't bear fascism. They move constantly between cities, settling down in Modena, where Libera quickly collides with the fascist political commissar Franco Testa (Philippe Leroy). Libera has to suffer awful moments due to her attachment to the resistance, and to the political and sexual harassment from Testa.

Title: 94. Cornbread, Earl and Me
description: A 12-year-old is traumatised by the murder of his friend, a star basketball player.

Title: 95. Alice Cooper: Welcome to My Nightmare
description: An Alice Cooper concert hosted by Vincent Price, with Alice Cooper's trademark "horror" stage act, and performances of some of his hit songs, including "Only Women Bleed," "School's Out" and "Steven."

Title: 96. That Malicious Age
description: Gardener Napoleone takes a job in a southern-Italian villa and quickly finds himself embroiled in a menage-a-trois with Paola and her mother, which soon leads to sex, death and mayhem.

Title: 97. Last Stop on the Night Train
description: Sadistic thugs terrorise two teenage girls on a train, cheered on by a twisted woman.

Title: 98. Snuff
description: A so-called "snuff" film involving the exploits of a cult leader leading a gang of bikers in a series of supposedly real killings on film.

Title: 99. The Killer Elite
description: A former hit man protects a colleague's Asian target.

Title: 100. The Chaos Class
description: Lazy, uneducated students share a very close bond. They live together in the dormitory, where they plan their latest pranks. When a new headmaster arrives, the students naturally try to overthrow him. A comic war of nitwits follows.

Title: 101. The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix
description: Reodor Felgen decides that he will enter a car race to defeat his former friend who has stolen his plans for a car.

Title: 102. Deewaar
description: Vijay struggles as a dockworker and eventually becomes a leading figure of the underworld, while his younger brother Ravi is an educated, upright policeman. This divide causes problems in their relationship.

Title: 103. Lips of Blood
description: Frederick sees a photograph of a ruined seaside castle, which triggers a strange childhood memory. He then goes on a strange quest to find the castle and the beautiful woman who lives there.

Title: 104. A Genius, Two Partners and a Dupe
description: Three rogues set out to rob $300,000 from an Indian-hating cavalry major.

Title: 105. Summer School Teachers
description: A trio of naive, but eager young Midwestern women go to California to teach summer school classes at Regency High School.

Title: 106. Breakheart Pass
description: John Deakin is being transported, as a prisoner, on a train with supplies and medicine to Fort Humboldt, Nevada, so he can help aid the remote garrison of Fort Humboldt.

Title: 107. Hustle
description: At the instigation of a grieving father, a Los Angeles cop investigates the suspicious circumstances of a girl's apparent suicide.

Title: 108. Smile
description: A social comedy about a beauty pageant for young Californian women, held annually in Santa Rosa, and how it affects the locals and participants.

Title: 109. Baldiz
description: The tragicomic story of a man marrying the wrong girl.

Title: 110. The Hiding Place
description: During WWII, a Dutch family caught hiding Jews is sent to a concentration camp, where their Christian faith helps them endure the hardships.

Title: 111. That's the Way of the World
description: Record executives want a highly-regarded record producer to focus on a white pop act whom they feel has the sound America wants. To keep his creative integrity, Buckmaster carefully begins to fight the system that has made him the respected producer he has become.

Title: 112. Bullet Train
description: Criminals plant a bomb on a high-speed train. It will explode when the train slows down, unless a ransom is paid.

Title: 113. Hester Street
description: In 1896, a Russian Jewish woman immigrates to New York City's Lower East Side to reunite with her Americanized husband, but she has difficulty assimilating.

Title: 114. Lover Boy
description: A telegram has just arrived ant the Persichette home in Italy. It seems that their late grandfather's second wife, Maria Juana, is traveling from Venezuela to Italy to visit her stepson and two grandchildren. The youngest of the boys is given the task of picking up grandma at the airport. Expecting an aged widow, he is stunned , amazed and aroused by the incredible beauty that awaits him.

Title: 115. W.W. and the Dixie Dancekings
description: W.W. Bright is a robber with a heart of gold who travels the South robbing gas stations. When he hijacks their car, he meets an aspiring country band and, trailed by religious zealot cop, Bright helps the band make it big while on the run.

Title: 116. The Travelling Players
description: Greece, 1939-1952: Fascist, Nazi, and Communist conflict, as seen through the eyes of a family of travelling provincial players.

Title: 117. Sharon's Baby
description: A woman gives birth to a baby, but this is no ordinary one. The child is seemingly possessed by the Devil.

Title: 118. Eyeball
description: A maniac killer in a red cape and hood is killing off American tourists on a tour bus by gouging out their eyeballs.

Title: 119. The Romantic Englishwoman
description: A marriage crisis between a writer and his wife leads her to flee to Germany and eventually return with another man, through whom the writer is going to overcome his writer's block.

Title: 120. The Suspicious Death of a Minor
description: While investigating the brutal murder of a young prostitute, a detective uncovers a sex-trafficking ring with connections to powerful people.

Title: 121. The Wild Party
description: With the arrival of talking pictures, a silent film comedian (a Roscoe 'Fatty' Arbuckle-type) throws a lavish party to try and save his failing career. His plan is to release one last, great silent masterpiece.

Title: 122. Legend of the Werewolf
description: Paris, 19th century. A man who has been raised by wolves works at a zoo. But on full moon nights he transforms into a dangerous beast. Professor Paul is in charge of hunting him down as the young man develops an obsession for a prostitute.

Title: 123. Sholay
description: After his family is murdered by a notorious and ruthless bandit, a former police officer enlists the services of two outlaws to capture the bandit.

Title: 124. Bugs Bunny Superstar
description: Looney Tunes documentary film hosted by Bob Clampett, including nine complete cartoons from the 40s and the artists behind the characters.

Title: 125. Ägget är löst! En hårdkokt saga
description: When the son of a tyrannical factory owner rebels against him, the father decides to teach the son a lesson, in the most extreme way.

Title: 126. La polizia ha le mani legate
description: In a crowded hotel in downtown Milan a bomb has been planted. The timer on its detonator has only minutes to run. A young cop discovers it by accident and is drawn into a terrifying nightmare of intrigue, brutality and ruthless killing.

Title: 127. Apoorva Raagangal
description: Drama and melodrama follow two relationships involving single parents.

Title: 128. Zvezda plenitelnogo schastya
description: In December 1825, distinguished members of the Russian military, most of whom were quite affluent and of noble lineage, took it upon themselves to stir revolution against the autocratic and tyrannical Czar Nikolai I in the wake of his not honoring (or even acknowledging) the drafting of a constitution for the Russian people. The revolution failed miserably and the conspirators (known as the Decembrists) were weeded out by the czar himself. One by one, each of the conspirators confess and are systematically exiled to the harsh winters of Siberia, slated to work and wither in a prison/mine. The wives of the conspirators are faced with the prospect of leaving the bosom of wealth and family (including their own children) to be with their husbands in the brutal Siberian locale. If they agree to this, they face having their illustrious social stations stripped away and certain disdain from everyone around them. Among these remarkable women is a princess exiled from France who falls in love with a man soon to be exiled. The film is the story of their unfathomable sacrifice and their dogged desire to be reunited with the men they love, despite the conditions and the circumstances.

Title: 129. Crime and Passion
description: A Vienna financier embezzles money from his firm and clients, forces his girlfriend to marry an old cuckold voyeur industrialist and runs for his life when the industrialist sends killers after him.

Title: 130. The School Teacher
description: Edwige Fenech plays the sexy private teacher of Franco (Alfredo Pea) who immediately falls madly in love with her. Franco tries and tries to seduce her by faking his own suicide.

Title: 131. The Beast
description: In order to inherit a fortune a young woman agrees to marry a young man. She soon discovers that his family harbours a dark past involving a monstrous beast.

Title: 132. So Young, So Lovely, So Vicious...
description: Angela is not happy about her daddy's choice for a new wife and does everything she can to destroy her stepmother-to-be.

Title: 133. The Sunshine Boys
description: A vaudeville duo agree to reunite for a television special, but it turns out that they can't stand each other.

Title: 134. Black Emanuelle
description: A globe trotting photojournalist enters Nairobi's permissive social world, where attraction, jealousy, and cultural fascination blur the line between professional independence and personal desire.

Title: 135. Lisztomania
description: Composer and pianist Franz Liszt (Roger Daltrey) attempts to overcome his hedonistic life-style while repeatedly being drawn back into it by the many women in his life and fellow composer Richard Wagner (Paul Nicholas).

Title: 136. The Sweet Aunts
description: The young and inexperienced teenager Libero is taken into custody by his anarchist grandfather. Lusting for their nephew, 3 females obtain guardianship of him from him. Then he discovers the joys of sex.

Title: 137. La Collegiale
description: The sexually naive Daniela returns home from boarding school only to realize that her family is involved in an excess of bed-hopping and sexual perversion.

Title: 138. The Other Side of the Mountain
description: Young ski champion Jill Kinmont is left paralyzed after a tragic skiing accident. Her best friend suffers the same fate after contracting polio. Jill must slowly put her life back together again with the help of those close to her.

Title: 139. The Sensuous Nurse
description: A rich widower suffers from cardiac trouble, and his greedy heirs hire a seductive nurse in the hopes of inducing a heart attack.

Title: 140. Waves of Lust
description: A young couple becomes embroiled with the personal problems of another couple on a yacht moored off Sicily during a turbulent weekend of fun, games, sex games, betrayal, spouse abuse, and murder.

Title: 141. The Teasers
description: Loredana, a schoolgirl, exploits her innocence, seducing students and teachers. After losing virginity to an older man, she discovers life's deeper meanings beyond mere seduction.

Title: 142. Chupke Chupke
description: A newly wedded husband plays a practical joke on his wife's family with full support from his wife and friends.

Title: 143. The Private Lesson
description: A sexy piano teacher is the object of desire for one of the boys in her class.

Title: 144. Out of Season
description: Ann and Joanna, a mother-daughter duo, run a hotel on an island. When they receive an unexpected guest, Joe, who had an affair with Ann years ago, Joanna express her feelings for him.

Title: 145. Let's Do It Again
description: Two Atlanta men raise funds for their charity by rigging boxing matches in New Orleans, but their tricks attract the mob's attention.

Title: 146. Countess Perverse
description: Two wealthy aristocrats lure a virginal girl to a Spanish island for a night of sex, death and cannibalism.

Title: 147. Abigail Lesley Is Back in Town
description: A seductive woman who left her small fishing town long ago after being caught with another woman's husband, returns to shake up the place by seducing everyone, including the woman and her girlfriends.

Title: 148. Trip with the Teacher
description: A teacher and her class of female students take a class trip to the desert. Their bus breaks down, and they find themselves terrorized by a gang of psycho bikers.

Title: 149. Zorro
description: In the New World, a new Spanish governor finds the province of Nueva Aragón under the iron fist of the corrupt Colonel Huerta and vows to bring justice under the guise of a masked avenger.

Title: 150. Dolemite
description: After he is released from jail, a pimp takes on the criminals and corrupt police officers who framed him in the first place.

Title: 151. Emanuelle and Francoise
description: A woman plots to take revenge on the man that abused her sister.

Title: 152. Dr. Minx
description: A female physician finds no fun in brief affairs. Her luck finally seems to change with her latest lover, but when she learns that he is more interested in her money than her, murder ensues.

Title: 153. Capone
description: The story of the rise and fall of the infamous Chicago gangster Al Capone and the control he exhibited over the city during the prohibition years.

Title: 154. Mitchell
description: A tough, slobby, honest cop tries to simultaneously take down heroin dealers and a corrupt businessman who murdered a burglar, even if it costs him his life.

Title: 155. El pequeño Robin Hood
description: En un pueblo del oeste norteamericano, durante el siglo XIX, un viejo gitano de nombre Aramís, acompañado del pequeño Robin Hood y Lucifer, un chimpancé, se dedica a hacer actos de arquería que impresionan para ganarse la vida.

Title: 156. The Strongest Man in the World
description: Dexter Riley and his friends accidentally discover a new chemical mixed with a cereal seems to give anyone temporary superhuman strength.

Title: 157. The Battle of Chile: Part I
description: The chronicle of the political tension in Chile in 1973 and of the violent counter revolution against the democratically elected government of Salvador Allende.

Title: 158. Four of the Apocalypse
description: In 1873, four petty criminals - three men and a pregnant woman - wander through the trackless terrain of Utah, where they are hounded by a sadistic bandit.

Title: 159. Mahogany
description: Tracy is a black girl with no financial resources who struggles to be able to afford fashion college. Her goal is to become an internationally famous fashion designer.

Title: 160. Moonrunners
description: Grady and Bobby Lee run moonshine for Uncle Jesse, who prides himself on his old-school moonshining methods, and refuses to buckle in to the 'big business moonshine' of Jake, who controls these parts for New York mobsters.

Title: 161. Carry on Behind

description: A young Venusian girl lands on Earth to explore the planet. She lands in Soho in London, UK where she has ample opportunities to research sex on Earth.

Title: 182. Black Mass
description: "Black Mass" is reputed to be the only literal representation ever made of an authentic satanic rite. It is based on transcripts of the actual rite, obtained by producer-director Ray Hoersch, reportedly a former producer of pornographic films. Mr. Hoesch reportedly attempted to film the actual ceremony, but failing that, he was able to obtain transcripts of the bizarre and profane ritual, including the mystical incantations. The movie is thus described as more of a documentary than a "scary story." In the words of Mr. Hoersch, "The Satanic Mass is the exact inverse of the Catholic ceremony. Every part of it is reserved in blasphemy for its intention is, a deliberate corruption, a parody of the mass. "Starting with the processional, the ritual uses a nude as the altar piece. The second section is a baptism, in which a girl dressed in white renounces her Christianity and seals her pact with the devil. And the third part is the Invocation to Lust - you'll have to see that."- "Offensive Material: Leaders Condemn Black Mass Film" - Lake Shore Visitor (Friday, March 7, 1975)

description: While on dispatch in Sydney to assist in the extradition of a drug courier, a tough Hong Kong cop wages a one-man war against Australia's most powerful kingpin.

Is there any secret beyond a door?

description: The continued erotic adventures of a British boy trying to make money and meet ladies, this time as a member of a pop band.

Title: 200. Rancho Deluxe
description: Two drifters, of widely varying backgrounds, rustle cattle and try to avoid being caught in contemporary Montana.

Title: 201. Overlord
description: During World War 2, a young lad's called up and, with increasing sense of foreboding, undertakes his army training for D-day.

description: A beautiful woman (Laura Antonelli) engages in affairs with two men, playing them against each other. Set in the decadent Roaring Twenties, the triangle dissolves against suicide and fascism.

Title: 211. Bed Hostesses
description: A man spends an afternoon in a Sex Shop watching soft core porn videos on a Peep-Show machine. When each video ends he announces to the viewer that the videos disgust him. Each video he watches shows at least one actress fully naked.

description: A group of juvenile delinquents are transferred to a new prison, where the corrupt staff takes advantage of the vulnerable inmates, and fight for dominance and backstabbing is the inmates' only way to survive.

Title: 213. Adam and Nicole
description: Brothers Martin and Paul Barnard are summoned to the family home after their father's death, but they're not allowed in the house until the reading of the will. They stay in the cottage occupied by their father's servants, Adam and Nicole.

description: July 1942. Soviet forces are retreating in the face of a massive German onslaught towards Stalingrad. An infantry platoon is tasked with holding a vital hill in order to give their comrades time to cross the Don River and regroup.

Title: 221. The Happy Hooker
description: In the first of three films on the life of Xaviera Hollander, the famous hooker from Holland traces her career as madam of the biggest and most profitable bordellos in New York.

Title: 222. Linda Lovelace for President
description: Follows Linda Lovelace's fictional grass roots campaign to run for president.

Title: 223. The Cheaters
description: Luca Altieri, a gambler and poker master, works for "The President," running gambling houses. Complications arise when Luca falls for Maria Luisa, the girlfriend of Corrado, the son of "The President."

description: Giorgio is a greedy adulterer who makes a deal with a serial killer to dispose of his wealthy wife, Nora. Unfortunately, a thrill-seeking young couple steal the killer's car with Nora's corpse in the trunk, ending up at a run-down seaside villa.

description: The twisted tale of Caleb, and his alter ego Lester. After being pushed around too far, Caleb transforms into Lester and returns to those who have wronged him.

description: A criminal attempts insurance fraud and diamond heist. His girlfriend kills him, gets imprisoned, and undergoes involuntary electric shock treatments.

Title: 228. The Spiral Staircase
description: In a remake of the 1940s film, Helen has been incapable of speech since seeing her husband die - will she become the target of a deranged serial killer targeting disabled people?

Title: 229. Street Girls
description: When a middle-aged father searches for his dropout daughter Angel, his quest takes him into the underworld of prostitutes, pimps, drug addicts, and thieves.

Title: 230. The Little Mermaid
description: A mermaid falls in love with a human prince, which leads to tragedy.

description: Beautiful Maria fled to Saint-Tropez with her older lover. She was promised marriage, but as they broke into homes, nurtured their love, and planned robberies, secrets were revealed and things spiraled out of control.

description: Rafferty, living in squalor near Hollywood, doesn't put up a fight when kooks McKinley and Rita hitch a ride to New Orleans; Rafferty is charmed by the misfits. The three drive to Las Vegas and later Tucson, where their bond unravels.

description: A traditional girl from the provinces arrives in Madrid to spend a few days with her sister and reconsider her marriage. There she will meet new people and meet the young revolutionaries as well as the nightlife of the capital.

description: A fugitive enforcer in New Orleans gets caught up in his boss's larger crime network, prompting a violent war between rival syndicates. He fights to survive as the bloodshed escalates.

description: Anne-Marie Stretter, wife of a French diplomat, lives in 1930s India. She takes many lovers as systems of oppression decay around her.

description: After a failed assassination attempt on the Mongol emperor, four martial artists train to learn advanced kung fu techniques in order to kill the Khan and avenge their falling comrades, and Marco Polo is sent by the emperor to kill them.

description: After selling his cattle in town, ranch owner Morgan unexpectedly dies, and his foreman Pike has to deliver the payroll to Sonora, despite the perilous journey during which he's followed by many shady characters who want the money.

description: Daninsky joins a Yeti expedition in the Himalayas but gets captured by cannibalistic nymphs guarding a Buddhist temple. They turn him into a werewolf where he encounters a sadistic bandit while roaming the mountains.

description: After a whirlwind romance, a mechanic and waitress's playful prank at a store spirals into tragedy, forcing the young lovers to flee as both police and guilt pursue them across the country.

Title: 265. Gun Moll
description: A happy-go-lucky prostitute gets mixed up with the Mafia.

Title: 267. Kiss of the Tarantula
description: A disturbed teenage girl unleashes her pet tarantula against her "enemies."

Title: 268. Love Under the Elms
description: During a vacation, a teenager couple falls in love. Then their single parents fall in love too.

Title: 269. Demon Witch Child
description: A young girl becomes possessed by a woman from a witches cult, who seeks vengeance, terror, and confusion around her family and the town folks.

Title: 270. The Sunday Woman
description: The investigation of the murder of ambiguous architect Garrone takes Police Commissioner Santamaria to the Turinese high society, but the results are unclear. In the meanwhile, another murder takes place.

description: Sheriff Buford Pusser continues his one-man war against moonshiners and a ruthless crime syndicate after the murder of his wife in late-1960s Tennessee.

description: After his friend is killed as a result of a war between two crime families, a biker vows to destroy the families and rescue a boy they have kidnapped.

description: Randy Milkman Davey bites off more than he can chew when he starts to deliver more than pints of milk to some of the bored housewives on his route. In a short space of time he finds himself engaged to two different women; on the receiving end of a bad beating from the local gangster whose girlfriend has been two-timing him with Davey; and finally he ends up in court on a rape charge when an irate husband comes home unexpectedly and discovers Terry and his wife in a compromising situation.

Title: 274. Alfie Darling
description: Alfie Elkins resumes his womanizing, encountering the sophisticated Abby Summers. His pursuit is hindered by his past with Norma and a jealous husband reminding him of his wife Fay.

Title: 275. Africa Express
description: A goods trader in southern Africa aids a mysterious nun in escaping the clutches of a dangerous ivory and animal trafficker.

Title: 276. A Haunted Turkish Bathhouse
description: A sly gangster hatches a plot against his own wife, who works at a brothel-cum-bathhouse, with the help of the bathhouse owner's wife.

description: A mountain man captures a beautiful but manipulative city woman and goes to excessive lengths to please her every whim.

description: Walter Petit is the laughing stock of the secretaries at the office.

description: Swayamsiddha is the story of woman power and narrates how a woman can transform a society through her courage and will.

description: A young woman participates (unknowingly) in a satanic ceremony and gets possessed by the spirit of her late father.

Title: 281. The Black Gestapo
description: General Ahmed has started an inner-city People's Army to try and relieve the misery of the citizens of Watts. When the locals are put under increasing pressure by Mafia thugs, Ahmed's second-in-command Colonel Kojah asks for permission to start a protection squad to take more direct action. Ahmed fears this protection squad will just turn into a vigilante mob, and his prediction soon proves correct. Will Ahmed be able to wrest control back from the power-mad Kojah, or will he be the mob's next victim?

Title: 282. Psychic Killer
description: A former mental patient uses astral projection to destroy the people he believes have wronged him.

Title: 283. The Specialist
description: A determined lawyer battles a ruthless businessman over control of a local lake's resources, leading to escalating tensions and confrontations in their small community.

Title: 284. End of the Game
description: When a Swiss cop is murdered, a veteran homicide inspector and a rookie are assigned to solve the case but they are obstructed by interfering Swiss politicians.

Title: 285. When Girls Make Love
description: Schoolgirl Report 9 revolves around two carloads of kids who've just left a drinking party, engage in a high-speed race and predictably have a wreck. During their investigation, the police reflect on the histories of several of the teens involved in the accident: Scene 1: Petra Klassman (Gina Janssen) has just turned 18, and against her parents' wishes, decides to marry Horst, an auto mechanic. Their honeymoon is a bust, thanks to a nosy old innkeeper. And marital bliss is also elusive, as the differences in their social and intellectual levels become more evident. Within a few months, Petra is back in class, a single schoolgirl once again. Scene 2: Tessy Van Straaten relates the tale of her wealthy classmate, Lilo (Puppa Armbruster), who hosts an orgy for her fellow students while the folks are out of town. The virginal Tessy reluctantly agrees to go, despite efforts by an older classmate, Paul Bellmann, to dissuade her. She is surprised, therefore, when Paul shows up at the party loaded down with extra booze for the punchbowl. In reality, he's spiked the punch with sleeping drugs in order to rescue Tessy from Lilo's friends. And Lilo's parents are confronted with a house full of knocked-out naked teenagers when they return home. Scene 3: Elke Parsberg (Uschi Karnat) is called to the hospital to fill in some background on her unconscious friend, Susanne Ströhmeyer (Sandra Atia). Susi's trouble began when her stepfather caught them experimenting one night, and he used her fear of exposure to sexually abuse her. Inevitably, her mother catches the two of them, and her stepfather concocts a story that makes Susi look like the sexual predator. However, Susi's doctor has determined she's pregnant, and Elke lays out the whole sordid affair - leaving it to the doctor's conscience what to do. Scene 4: Katja (Christine Szenetra) reluctantly agrees to attend her parents' 20th wedding anniversary - put off by their severe, authoritarian attitude toward her. But she's unaware of their complete transformation. In fact, she's quite put out when she finds their new personas to be superficially hip and overly permissive. Scene 5: Claudia (Marianne Dupont) has been traumatized by a flasher in the park, causing terror at the sight of a penis. Naturally, this is a problem for her boyfriend, Achim Forster, which culminates in frustration boiling over, as he leaves her for the fateful drinking party. Scene 6: Monika Schmieding is a high school drop-out who's taken up with Karl Henschel, an unemployed leather worker. Karl can't find work, so Monika goes to Albert's party to see if she can 'negotiate' a job for him. However, she gets cold feet at the last minute - but sometimes good intentions are enough!

Title: 286. Weak Spot
description: A quiet man in his forties is arrested for a minor reason and sent to prison.

Title: 287. Journey Into Fear
description: An American geologist accidentally discovers oil in Turkey. Several assassins are sent to eliminate him, but they all fail. He eventually boards a passenger boat to try to escape. However, one of the passengers is an undercover assassin.

Title: 288. Hearts of the West
description: During the 1930s, Lewis Tate aspires to be the next great American Western writer. When he travels to California, he's recruited by Bert Kessler, a Hollywood unit manager, to star in a series of low-rent Westerns.

Title: 289. Aandhi
description: Hotel manager J.K. (Sanjeev Kumar) works there. One day, he bravely steps in to save Aarti, the drunken daughter of a politician (Suchitra Sen). Aarti and J.K. have a small ceremony to celebrate their marriage after falling in love. The married pair decides to separate after a few years because of several issues. Aarti and J.K. eventually cross paths again when she has achieved political success. Both of them sense a connection despite their distance, but Aarti is reluctant to speak up for fear of having her reputation ruined and endangering her profession. However, when the opposing party conducts a rally to disparage and humiliate Aarti Devi, When she gets there, she informs the populace and voters of her decision to leave her husband and family in order to serve this nation's citizens. The public respects her and is deeply moved by her voice and selflessness. J.K. arrives there as well and offers her support; she is overjoyed and moves on. She is elected and goes on to have a fulfilling life.

Title: 290. Jessi's Girls
description: Jessica goes for revenge after being raped by a bunch of hoodlums.

Title: 291. The Novice
description: A young man comes back to his provincial home town to visit his dying uncle (blacklisted American actor Lionel Stander). His uncle is being attended to by a night nurse and novice nun (Gloria Guida in a nun's habit).

description: Foxy Lady Cocoa is out to take down her mobster boyfriend.

Title: 298. The True Story of Eskimo Nell
description: The film's unlikely protagonist is a mild-mannered window peeper named Dead-Eye Dick (Max Gillies), who spies on a Mexican couple.

Title: 299. The Return of the Exorcist
description: A priest becomes involved in demonology and exorcisms.

Title: 300. The 'Human' Factor
description: After his family is brutally murdered for an unknown reason, a computer engineer sets out to find those responsible.

Title: 301. A Dragonfly for Each Corpse
description: A killer is cleaning up the streets of Milan by murdering those considered as deviant. An ornamental dragonfly, soaked in the blood of the victim, is left on each body.

Title: 302. The Killer of Dolls
description: A groundskeeper's son, who is mentally unstable due to childhood trauma, goes on a murdering spree where his perception of reality is distorted by imagining people as mannequins and vice versa.

Title: 303. Flatfoot in Hong Kong
description: In the Far-East, Italian police inspector Rizzo and American mobster Frank Barella co-operate in finding clues about the identity of a dirty cop in Rizzo's narcotics department.

Title: 304. Frozen Scream
description: Mad scientists turn people into frozen zombies and the zombies wreak havoc and kill people.

Title: 305. Foreplay
description: Three vignettes about a man who buys a weird doll, a writer who is visited by his muse and a kidnapper with very odd demands who holds a VIP.

Title: 306. Winterhawk
description: In 1845 Montana, a Blackfoot Chief tries to buy a cure for his tribe's smallpox infection, but the white settlers are unsympathetic, forcing the Indian Chief to resort to desperate measures.

Title: 307. The Premonition
description: A foster mother begins experiencing psychic visions after the psychotic biological mother of her foster daughter begins stalking them.

Title: 308. The Maids
description: A film version of Genet's play. Two house cleaners, Solange and Claire, hate their employers and, while they are out, take turns at dressing up as Madame and insulting her.

Title: 309. L'éventreur de Notre-Dame
description: A madman conducts a private inquisition to exorcise demons by torturing women to death.

Title: 310. Brother and Sister
description: A young man and his pretty step-sister find that they are very much in love with each other when they are reunited after spending years apart. Naturally this leads to both expected and unexpected problems.

Title: 311. Jai Santoshi Maa
description: Sathyavati is a great devotee of Santoshi Maa. But when Narada decides to test her devotion, she faces several challenges in her life.

Title: 312. Nazareno Cruz and the Wolf
description: A young man from a mountain village faces a legendary curse threatening to turn him into a wolf. When he falls in love at twenty, the Devil makes him choose between wealth and his beloved-or accept a monstrous fate.

Title: 313. Reflections in Black
description: A number of women are brutally murdered. It quickly becomes apparent that all the victims are connected to a woman who had been having illicit affairs with them.

Title: 314. Mean Johnny Barrows
description: Discharged from the army, an ex-GI is hired as a hit-man by a crime syndicate that is at war with another Mafia family.

Title: 315. It Seemed Like a Good Idea at the Time
description: A divorced man's obsession with reclaiming his ex-wife leads to kidnapping. Despite her remarriage, they still have encounters. As his actions escalate, the Toronto police work to unravel the case.

Title: 316. Xala
description: A corrupt politician is cursed with impotence on the night of his third wedding after embezzling 100 tons of rice.

Title: 317. Diamonds
description: Richard Roundtree (SHAFT), Robert Shaw (JAWS) and $100 Million of the Hottest Rocks in the World!

Title: 318. A Woman Called Sada Abe
description: A true-life tale of a broken woman whose hedonistic tryst with a high-class restaurateur resulted in a horrific crime of passion that littered Tokyo headlines in 1936.

Title: 319. The Gypsy
description: Hugo Sennart, a French gypsy, is wanted by the police for theft. Gypsy has a couple of scores to settle and one more little thing to do before he fades into the shadows.

Title: 320. Pleasure Party
description: A philandering husband convinces his wife to have affairs, believing she can't find a lover as interesting as he.

Title: 321. Lepke
description: Louis 'Lepke' Buchalter is head of Murder Inc., the syndicate that spattered the headlines of the day with blood.

Title: 322. That Lucky Touch
description: A pacifist newswoman covering a NATO meeting becomes entangled with her neighbor, an international arms dealer.

Title: 323. Tickled Pink
description: A Victorian aristocrat unknowingly acquires a former asylum with secret passages inhabited by Jack the Ripper, intending to turn it into a romantic retreat.

Title: 324. Down Town
description: In Puerto Rico, a down-on-his-luck private detective is hired by a woman to take photos of her husband, a notorious nightclub owner.

Title: 325. Special Section
description: In occupied France during World War II a German officer is murdered. The collaborationist Vichy government decides to pin the murder on six petty criminals. Loyal judges are called in to convict them as quickly as possible.

Title: 326. Galileo
description: Galileo Galilei, his telescopic discoveries, support of Copernican theory, conflict with Catholic Church leading to imprisonment, and influence on future scientists like Newton and Kepler.

Title: 327. Tokyo Deep Throat
description: Kumi is a model who is sought after by her wealthy father. When she refuses to satisfy him orally, he takes a team of surgeons and transplant her clitoris to in her throat.

Title: 328. Aloïse
description: The unsuccessful Swiss artist Aloïse Corbaz finds work at the court of the German emperor and gets infatuated. Showing frank symptoms of insanity she is hospitalized.

Title: 329. Strange Love of the Vampires
description: In a 19th century village, a young aristocrat suffering from a terminal disease finds herself being drawn to the underground world of vampires and their strange rituals.

Title: 330. Dharmatma
description: Wealthy, powerful and influential Seth Dharamdas leads a financially secure life in a palatial mansion. He is known to come to the aid of all people who are beyond any hope of assistance, and this leads to him being known as "Dharmatma". But Seth Dharamdas does have a number of skeletons in his closet, and a parallel life as a gangster. The only person Dharamdas hates and fears is none other than his very own son, Ranbir, who has sworn that he will never compromise with his father's dark career, and threatens to expose him. Dharamdas has never conceded surrender or defeat at the hands of any mortal, and will never even consider to do so - even if this means the death of Ranbir. Songs include "Tere cheherey mein woh jadoo hai..."; "Tum ne kisise kabhi pyar kiya hai, pyar bhara dil kisiko diya hai...".

Title: 331. The Seventh Company Has Been Found
description: The French army's 7th Company experiences a severe setback during World War II when it gets separated from other units of its army. They disguise themselves as officers to escape death when they are taken prisoner by the Germans.

Title: 332. The Daughter of Emanuelle
description: Emanuelle's daughter Pussy introduces her to her new lover and she suffers a flash of recognition.

Title: 333. Duck in Orange Sauce
description: When facing a request of divorce, Livio accepts, but sets up a last weekend together with his secretary and his wife's lover.

Title: 334. Julie
description: Julie is an Anglo-Indian girl with a loving, but alcoholic father and a domineering mother, a younger brother and sister. She falls in love with her best friend's brother Shashi Bhattacharya, a Hindu boy, and she has a passionate encounter with him, which leaves her pregnant. He goes away to college, not knowing about her condition. Her mother is distraught when Julie tells her about the pregnancy. They don't tell the rest of the family. Her mother thinks about getting Julie an abortion, but a devout Christian talks her out of it. Julie is sent away to have her baby in secret. The rest of the family is told that Julie got a job. When she comes back home, she runs into her Hindu boyfriend and tells him everything. He agrees to marry her, but his mother objects to the mixed marriage, not knowing about the baby born in secret. Julie's mother doesn't want the marriage either, as she and the rest of the family want to go to England.

Title: 335. Wolf Guy
description: A man with a special power attempts to help a cursed woman.

Title: 336. Peeper
description: In 1947, a smart-mouthed Brit working in L.A. as a private eye (or peeper) is on a case to find the long lost daughter of a shady client pursued by two dangerous goons. The case leads him to a rich oddball Beverly Hills family.

Title: 337. Inside Out
description: Thirty years after the end of WWII, a team of former GIs and German soldiers plan to retrieve Nazi loot hidden in Soviet-occupied East Germany, its exact location only known to an imprisoned Nazi war criminal.

Title: 338. Number Two
description: An analysis of the power relations in an ordinary family.

Title: 339. 7 morts sur ordonnance
description: Dr. Brézé and his sons, all surgeons with limited abilities fight any competition on their sector with all means.

Title: 340. The Flesh of the Orchid
description: A disturbed young woman is kept prisoner in a castle by her aunt for her money. The game-keeper, her guardian, tries to rape her but she escapes. In her flight she meets a man also running away, from two killers.

Title: 341. Slade in Flame
description: Light the Rock n' Roll spark with a Flame in the guise of Dave, Noddy, Jim and Don and their showcase of the rise and demise of rock band Flame.

Title: 342. Deadly Hero
description: When disturbed New York City (NYPD) cop Lacy rescues Sally, a beautiful cellist, from deranged crook Rabbit by shooting Rabbit in cold blood, he sets off a spark of publicity that brands him the city's hero.

Title: 343. Inn of the Damned
description: A sheriff investigates why the guests at a local hostelry check in but never check out.

Title: 344. Sixpack Annie
description: Busty, blonde and beautiful, Six-Pack Annie seeks to help her Aunt Tess raise $5,000 for the family diner...by trying to find a rich daddy.

Title: 345. Savage Man Savage Beast
description: A notorious mondo film depicting unbelievable and bizarre rituals, animal killing and cruelty, and people being killed and eaten, all by either animals or humans against each other or themselves.

Title: 346. The Executioner
description: Western intelligence agents try, by all means necessary, to prevent a Communist-bloc defector from leaving the West in his bid to return home to lead an uprising.

Title: 347. Attenti... arrivano le collegiali!
description: Students from a private girls' school spend a few days at a seaside hotel owned by one of their parents, where hijinks predictably ensue.

Title: 348. La Course à l'échalote
description: An awkward banker tracks down cabaret performers, who stole the ownership title of their nightclub.

Title: 349. Hustruer
description: Three women decides to go on a male-like ramp for a week instead of cooking dinner for their husbands for the sake of female liberation.

Title: 350. La supplente
description: A young substitute teacher arrives at an Italian high school. Male students are sexually attracted to her; initially, however, she does not give herself to any of them.

Title: 351. The Adolescents
description: A naive boarding school student becomes prey to sinister photographers trafficking in illicit images of underage girls for an exploitative magazine during a trip to London.

Title: 352. Graveyard of Honor
description: A self-destructive man becomes a powerful member of the Japanese mafia but quickly loses his self control. Based on the true story of Rikio Ishikawa.

Title: 353. King Dick
description: Little Dick, the well-endowed dwarf servant of Master Limpcock is being pursued by Nymphomania, an ugly witch who must have 69 orgasms to turn herself beautiful again.

Title: 354. Psycho from Texas
description: A drifter/hitman is hired by a local business man to kidnap the local oil baron. The hitman had been reared in squalor, suffering the abuses of his whoring mama. When the baron escapes his assistant must chase him while the hitman takes care of a few loose ends.

Title: 355. One Hundred Days After Childhood
description: A group of Russian teenagers spend their summer at a summer camp. Mitia falls in love and gets so occupied with his own problems that he forgets the others.

Title: 356. Sharks' Treasure
description: An aging fisherman finds a sunken treasure in shark-infested waters and is attacked by five escaping convicts.

Title: 357. True Story of Woman Condemned Continues
description: A woman who was gang raped is sent to prison after taking revenge on some of her rapists. Their, she witnesses firsthand the corruption and abuse the inmates go through, but her revenge is not over yet.

Title: 358. Our Family
description: A love story between a poor man and a rich girl. The rich girl's father tries to prevent their marriage and he declares a war against the poor boy's family.

Title: 359. The Golden Mass
description: A middle-aged couple invites a group of youngsters to their luxury villa to introduce them into the rituals and mystery of love and lust.

Title: 360. Mili
description: A reclusive, depressed man and a bubbly young woman fall in love but then find out that she has cancer.

Title: 361. Sunday Too Far Away
description: A hard-drinking but hard-working gun shearer leads a group of Outback sheep herders into striking after wealthy landowners attempt to drive them from their territory.

Title: 362. Newlywed Hell
description: The young and beautiful Yuki decides to leave her husband. She goes back to the place where she grew up. There she is initiated to S&M and bondage. But is it really the perfect cure to forget all about her past and regain happiness?

Title: 363. Rapiña
description: Two neighbors who had always lived in poverty witness a plane crash and decide to take anything they find valuable among the dead. They begin to experience greed.

Title: 364. Velké trápení
description: After the separation of her parents from her father, a 13-year-old girl is placed in an orphanage where she has difficulty settling in, but then begins to break away from her father because she sees through his selfishness.

Title: 365. The World Is a Wonderful Show
description: Candide, lovelorn youth and eternal seeker from the pages of Voltaire's immortal classic novel, finds himself thrown out of an entirely comfortable castle after his affection for the baron's daughter Cunegonde went a little too far down her thighs for her father's taste.

Title: 366. Catherine & Co.
description: An enterprising young prostitute decides to become her own corporation.

Title: 367. La gammick
description: Decided to 'make the States' a hit-man from Montreal accept a contract in New York to kill a mafioso boss, Frank Anastasia. Naturally the Americans don't accept what that 'stranger', that frog have done and track him back. Despaired he contact a radio talk show to tell his story trying to find a way to save the life of his partner in the hand of those who contract him.

Title: 368. Bloodbath
description: Hopeless American expatriates inhabit a small Spanish village where residents are mysteriously dying after the arrival of a religious cult.

Title: 369. Mondo Magic
description: This film is about tribes in Africa and South America who turn toward magic as a means of survival and way of life. The Mundari tribe in Africa herd cattle but do not slaughter them for meat. They make use of the cattle urine as an insect repellent and shower underneath their cows. They also use the dung as a body covering to further thwart insects and pest. The cattle are so prized to the Mundari that they are treated as a member of the family and a number of Mundari are shown puffing into the cattle's vagina to encourage an early birth. A hunt is then shown where the Mundari are able to bring down mighty Elephants and Giraffes with ease. Yet unlike sport hunters they hunt merely for survival and pay respect to the beast before eating them. The Dinka tribe is another group who praise their cattle but they bleed the cows and mix it in their milk to help sustain tribes during periods of hunger. They also migrate to different areas along the Nile as to not over consume their pastures. The camera then moves to the South American continent where The Yanawana people are shown in their full glory. They sleep in simple hammocks and allow their dogs every freedom. One woman is even shown suckling a puppy along with her own child. Hunters prepare to catch their meal and a feast of spiders, crab and tapir is enjoyed by all. The Yanawana hold a gathering each year where the shamans drink a mixture of the crushed skulls of their dead shamans to transfer the soul and release it to the heavens. Psychic healers in the Philippines are shown next, they appear to do surgery without leaving scars and impress those around them. Christians are then shown self inflicting wounds as a form of penance to their saints. The cameras move back to Africa where children in Ethiopia have their Uvula removed for no real reason known to us. An Arab woman takes her daughter to a woman called a Marabou and has her checked to insure she is still pure, others use her services to heal themselves with holy messages from the Koran. The final scene has a tribe which takes woman and uses them as fertility gods, they help insure fertility and a big family.

Title: 370. Salut les frangines
description: Denis spends a holiday at his friend's home, Marc. Staying with the family for several days, even though the Chotards have other things in mind than sex, he will have nice encounters with the girl of the house, Marianne, a young maid, and more.

Title: 371. Incorrigible
description: Having barely been released from prison, cunning conman Victor Vauthier once again plunges into a series of scams. He makes his way through life in new disguises and with original tricks - always accompanied by his eccentric uncle Camille.

Title: 373. Nights and Days
description: An epic saga of the Niechcic family, told from a woman's perspective. In 1914 in the war-torn Kaliniec, Barbara Niechcic remembers her youthful love, marriage hardships, family life in the countryside and finally her husband's death.

Title: 374. Sunburst
description: A couple on vacation in the woods is stalked by a pair of rapists.

Title: 376. Daguerreotypes
description: Portraits of the people that occupy the small shops of the Rue Daguerre, Paris, where the filmmaker lived.

Title: 377. Leonor
description: A female vampire rises from her crypt every night in search of children as her victims.

Title: 378. Till Eulenspiegel
description: In medieval Germany, poor and witty Till Eulenspiegel fools and cheats citizens, churchmen, and landlords. Although in most cases he uses his wit for personal well-being, he often helps the poor and weak. Eventually, he gains an influential but also dangerous position as royal fool at the court of the emperor.

Title: 379. Giochi erotici di una famiglia per bene
description: A man discovers his wife in bed with another man and decides to kill her. But the dead woman begins to appear to him, driving him crazy.

Title: 380. French Blue
description: The head of an aristocratic family died, so everyone gather to mourn him and see who gets what from his estate. Greed, lust, love and class conflict between the family and their payed servants create a real mess rather quickly.

Title: 381. Hedda
description: A strong-willed woman in a small Nordic town captivates local men while struggling against social constraints. Her destructive choices affect those around her, particularly a gifted writer whose work becomes a casualty of her inner turmoil

Title: 383. The Olsen Gang on the Track
description: After the Olsen Gang's money is stolen in Spain, Egon is arrested once more. Back in Denmark, they want to steal a railroad car full of gold bars to get their money back.

Title: 384. One Way or Another
description: In Miraflores, Cuba, the growing romance between Mario, a factory worker, and Yolanda, a schoolteacher, throws into relief the differences in their perspectives and values in Revolutionary Cuba.

Title: 385. Requiem for a Village
description: In a country cemetery in Suffolk, an elderly caretaker relives the memories of his youth, recalling rural and bucolic village life in a distant era.

Title: 386. Dracula in the Provinces
description: A boorish, snobish toothpaste factory owner, Constantino Nicosia, gives his wife and everyone a hard time having let success and wealth go to his head. But after the superticous Nicosia has an encounter with an elderly gypsy aunt, and a business trip to Romania results in another encounter with a suave vampire, named Count Dragalescu, Nicosia returns with blood-sucking like qualities which makes him re-examine his life and existence.

Title: 387. The Night They Robbed Big Bertha's
description: A rollicking account of a bungling, unsuccessful criminal who plots the perfect "caper" against illegal establishments and his first stop is Big Bertha's Massage Emporium.

Title: 388. Hennessy
description: Hennessy is an Irishman who believes in peace, but who has had connections to the I.R.A. After his family is killed he plots revenge, setting out to assassinate Queen Elizabeth II.

Title: 389. Northville Cemetery Massacre
description: Mayhem starts when a gang of bikers is accused of a sadistic rape in a small town.

Title: 390. Australia After Dark
description: A 1970s 'Ozploitation' documentary looking at a random collection of stories from the "dark side" of Australian culture.

Title: 391. Hustler Squad
description: World War II: Allied Command learns that in 60 days three Japanese generals and an admiral party at a bordello on a tiny Philippine island. It's fortified and hard to attack, so a creative, cynical major gets the assignment to figure something else. With the help of Paco, a Filipino guerrilla leader, the major devises a plan to put four women assassins among the prostitutes. He must recruit and train them, convince his general that an unarmed woman can best a man, and get them on the island. The rest is up to them. An imprisoned killer, a nurse with a fatal disease, a chippie on the lamb from the mob, and a Filipina whom the Japanese assaulted are his team. Can they do it?

Title: 392. Poor Pretty Eddie
description: A wrong turn on jazz singer Elizabeth Wetherly's road trip in the American South results in her car breaking down near an isolated lodge run by faded starlet Bertha Collins and her son - young, homicidal Elvis Presley impersonator Eddie.

Title: 393. The Blazer Girls
description: A group of private-school seniors want to raise money to buy a new bell for their school, so they hit on the idea of putting themselves on the market.

Title: 394. Il gatto mammone
description: Sicilian Lollo Mascalucia, a small pasta factory owner has been married to Rosalia for seven years, pretending to all his fellow villagers that he doesn't want a child.

Title: 395. Death at an Old Mansion
description: When a woman and her bridegroom are found dead in a double suicide the day after their wedding, it is up to the detective to figure out what could possibly have motivated them. Carefully and systematically, he pieces together the inner lives of the two.

Title: 396. Fabulous Fanny
description: Twenty-year old Seymour will stand to inherit $250,000 if he becomes a father by his twenty-first birthday, a quest which a number of buxom beauties are only too willing to assist him.

Title: 397. Mackintosh and T.J.
description: Roy is a ranch hand and a drifter. He takes a young man into his care and helps him to grow up.

Title: 398. The White, the Yellow, and the Black
description: A Swiss outlaw, a wannabe samurai and a sheriff set out to rescue a pony sent by the Japanese Emperor as a gift for the U.S. President, which is now being held for ransom by Indians.

Title: 399. Afonya
description: A carefree plumber spends his days drinking and chasing women, but the emptiness of his life starts catching up to him.

Title: 400. The Messiah
description: The story of the life of Jesus Christ.

Title: 401. Normande
description: The demands of her family and the stress of daily life drive the mind of a woman into permanent fantasy as a way to cope.

Title: 402. Blood Bath
description: The cast of a horror film go out for dinner with their director one night and they all exchange horror stories.

Title: 403. Sledovatelyat i gorata
description: Before going on leave an experienced magistrate assigns to his assistant a case that has been all but concluded. Everything has been proved. The facts are clear: a brutal murder has been committed. The suspect is a young, beautiful girl, who does not deny or remorse the murder. The only thing that remains to be done is to refer the case to the public prosecutor's office. The case is rather strange though. The murdered man had been a criminal blackmailer; the murderess is a timid girl of 17. The young magistrate tries to discover certain vital truth concealed beneath the obvious facts. The girl has pleaded guilty and the bulk of evidence is against her. The only question that has not been answered concerns the motive of the crime. The detective carefully questions the girl to find her real motives. From her story he learns that the girl is real victim. She arrived from the country and due to her naivety ended up in the apartment of a sexual maniac. Locked there for days and subject to sexual harassments, the girl views the ax she finds on the balcony as the only solution. The detective has to take the law into consideration, but he understands the girl and tries to extenuate the sentence.

Title: 404. Tesekkür Ederim Büyükanne
description: Mete the little boy of family, receives the grandmother from Italy. But the grandmother neither grand nor mother; just a young woman who will make Mete a man.

Title: 405. Lies My Father Told Me
description: A Jewish boy grows up in 1920s Montreal with a grandfather who tells stories and a father who won't work.

Title: 406. Man Friday
description: During the 17th century, shipwrecked English seaman Robinson Crusoe, after years of solitude, spots natives on his deserted Pacific island and befriends one who he names Friday.

Title: 407. Love Lesson
description: A German governess is hired to give German and piano lessons to the teenager son of a rich traditional family, in the 20s. But soon they get involved, and she teaches him love lessons instead.

Title: 408. Violent Rome
description: A detective sick and tired of the rampant crime and violence in his city, and constantly at odds with his superiors, is finally kicked out of the department for a "questionable" shooting of a vicious criminal. However, he is soon approached by a representative for a group of citizens who themselves are fed up with what they see as criminals going unpunished, and they make him an offer he may very well not refuse.

Title: 409. Dhoti Lota Aur Chowpatty
description: An assortment of characters living near Juhu, Chowpatty, meet, share comic, romantic, and fight scenes. This movie is remebered for the reverse casting as main heros such as Dharam and Sanjeev have wee bit roles, whereas the wee bit character roles usally played by Mohan Choti, and Farida Jalal, are the main characters. This movie is also remembered for it's songs: "Dhoti lota aur chowpatty yeh apne pyar ke saathi, eense apna rishta nahta, bakhi sarhi duniya maati.."; "Chal gai chal gai ishk ki goli chal gai..."; "Soh bar ki tobah phir bhi dil ne kar diya pyar, pyar, pyar, jo hoga dekha jayega jab ho hi gaya pyar pyar.."; "Thumak thumak chale chaal hath me kajal ki jori, gora badan, patli kamar...O gori tera roop bada mastana..".

Title: 410. Adoption
description: A lonely middle-aged woman wants to give birth to a child, but her acquaintance with dysfunctional teenagers leads her to the idea of adoption.

Title: 411. Cold Blood
description: A woman witnesses an attack, is forced to help the wounded man, escapes and ends up joining him after learning about his criminal past. Emotionally involved, she enters a desperate flight while their pursuers close in.

Title: 412. The Common Man
description: A family holiday turns to tragedy when hostilities between the French holidaymakers and a group of local Arab workers turns violent.

Title: 413. The Middleman
description: A bright and idealistic young man steels himself for the dog-eat-dog business world, only to flounder in a job market packed with thousands of other hopefuls.

Title: 414. Journey Into the Beyond
description: A "journey" into the world of the supernatural.

Title: 415. Hotel Pacific
description: A teenage country boy starts working in a restaurant of the famous Pacific Hotel in the 1930s. He soon discovers that to get promoted one needs to conform and sacrifice his dignity.

Title: 416. Hugo the Hippo
description: The Sultan of Zanzibar has a problem--his harbor is infested with sharks. To solve the problem, he brings in twelve hippos to keep the sharks away, and it works. But once the hippos are no longer needed, they become a nuisance and are massacred by Aban Khan--all but one little hippo named Hugo. What will become of the last of the Zanzibar hippos?

Title: 417. Chori Mera Kaam
description: Bhola Nath is a young petty criminal/robber/pickpocket whom works with a female acomplice and his former lover, Sharmii. Bhola unknowlingly is the illigetimate son of a police officer, named Kumar, whom has been tracking a shadowy gangster, named Amanarchard Rathore, whom Kumar imprisoned 20 years before and has now been paroled and resumed his life of crime. Bhola was abducted by Amanarchard's henchmen as a little boy, but escaped and was raised by a veteran thief named 'Mr. John,' while his Lt. Kumar and his wife and other son have long belived that their other son was dead.
